## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] I looked at the icon next to the others (`npm run dev:site`)

- [ ] Added a changeset (`npx changeset`) — minor for new icons, patch for fixes
- [ ] No `generated.*` or `build/` files committed
